messages.content: What happens to my card if I report it stolen?

response: When you report your card as stolen, AtlasBank will immediately cancel the card to prevent unauthorized use. After cancellation, a new card will be issued and sent to the address on file. You may also be asked to verify your identity for security purposes. If you have any direct debits or standing orders set up on the old card, they will need to be updated with your new card details. For more detailed information, I recommend checking the 'Card Issues' section of our FAQ on the AtlasBank website.
